```rust
    Var(String),
```

```rust
struct Parser<'a> { toks: Vec<Tok>, i: usize }

// additive: multiplicative (('+'|'-') multiplicative)*
fn parse_additive(&mut self) -> Result<Node, Error> {
    let mut l = self.parse_multiplicative()?;
    loop {
        match peek {
            Plus | Minus => { advance; let r = self.parse_multiplicative()?; l = BinOp(l, r) }
            _ => return Ok(l)
        }
    }
}

// multiplicative: unary (('*'|'/'|'%') unary)*
fn parse_multiplicative(...) {
    let mut l = self.parse_unary()?;
    loop {
        match peek { Star/Slash/Percent => { advance; r = parse_unary; l = ... } _ => return }
    }
}

// unary: ('+'|'-') unary | power
fn parse_unary(...) {
    match peek {
        Plus | Minus => { let pos = peek.pos; advance; let e = parse_unary(); Unary(op, e) }
        _ => parse_power()
    }
}

// power: primary ('^' unary)?
fn parse_power(...) {
    let base = self.parse_primary()?;
    if peek == Caret { advance; let e = self.parse_unary()?; BinOp(^(base, e)) } else Ok(base)
}

// primary: Num | Ident | Ident(args) | '(' expr ')'
fn parse_primary(...) {
    match peek {
        Num => { advance; Num }
        Ident => { advance; if peek == LParen { advance; args: loop { if peek == RParen break; arg = parse_additive(); if peek == Comma advance else return Err } } else Var }
        LParen => { advance; e = parse_additive(); expect RParen else UnexpectedEnd; e }
        _ => Err(UnexpectedToken(peek.pos))  // includes RParen at top level: `)` → UnexpectedToken(0)
    }
}
```

```rust
    match n {
        Node::Num(v) => Ok(*v),
        Node::Var(name) => vars.get(name).copied().ok_or_else(|| Error::UnknownVariable(name.clone())),
        Node::Call { name, args } => eval_call(name, args, vars),

                BinOp::Sub => Ok(a - eval_node(r, vars)?),
```
